string-array.name: rows
string-array.item: Auto keystone@@[ \"$(getprop persist.sys.tpryauto)\" = 1 ] && echo On || echo Off@@n=1; [ \"$(getprop persist.sys.tpryauto)\" = 1 ] && n=0; setprop persist.sys.tpryauto $n; if [ $n = 1 ]; then am broadcast -a android.intent.hotack_keystone --ei ratio 1 >/dev/null; else sh $P/zoom.sh reapply; fi
Auto focus@@[ \"$(getprop persist.sys.vafocus)\" = 1 ] && echo On || echo Off@@n=1; [ \"$(getprop persist.sys.vafocus)\" = 1 ] && n=0; setprop persist.sys.vafocus $n
Auto four corner@@[ \"$(getprop persist.sys.tpryxcrt)\" = 1 ] && echo On || echo Off@@n=1; [ \"$(getprop persist.sys.tpryxcrt)\" = 1 ] && n=0; setprop persist.sys.tpryxcrt $n
Screen recognition@@[ \"$(getprop persist.sys.mbrecognize)\" = 1 ] && echo On || echo Off@@n=1; [ \"$(getprop persist.sys.mbrecognize)\" = 1 ] && n=0; setprop persist.sys.mbrecognize $n
Obstacle avoidance@@[ \"$(getprop persist.sys.obstacle)\" = 1 ] && echo On || echo Off@@n=1; [ \"$(getprop persist.sys.obstacle)\" = 1 ] && n=0; setprop persist.sys.obstacle $n
Digital zoom (0-20)@@sh $P/zoom.sh get@@sh $P/zoom.sh step $1
Manual keystone (4 corners)@@echo@@am start --user 0 -n io.github.probonopd.hy310projection/.KeystoneActivity >/dev/null
Camera view@@echo@@pm grant io.github.probonopd.hy310projection android.permission.CAMERA || exit 1; am start --user 0 -n io.github.probonopd.hy310projection/.CameraActivity >/dev/null
Reset keystone@@echo@@sh $P/zoom.sh reset

Installation mode@@case $(CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-mirror) in 0) echo Front;; 1) echo Rear;; 2) echo Front ceiling;; 3) echo Rear ceiling;; *) echo error: unknown mode;; esac@@cur=$(CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-mirror) || exit 1; new=$(( (cur + $1 + 4) % 4 )); CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper set-mirror $new >/dev/null || exit 1; setprop persist.sys.panelvalue $new; if [ \"$(getprop persist.sys.camok)\" = 1 ] && [ \"$(getprop persist.sys.focusupdn)\" = 0 ]; then sh $P/zoom.sh remap $cur $new; fi; if [ \"$(getprop persist.sys.tpryauto)\" = 1 ]; then am broadcast -a android.intent.projective_mode -f 0x10000000 >/dev/null; fi

Picture mode@@CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-picmode@@cur=$(CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-picmode) || exit 1; i=0; n=0; for m in standard cinema vivid custom; do [ $m = $cur ] && i=$n; n=$((n+1)); done; new=$(echo standard cinema vivid custom | cut -d\' \' -f$(( (i + $1 + 4) % 4 + 1 ))); CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper set-picmode $new >/dev/null || exit 1

Brightness (picture)@@CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-pq 1@@cur=$(CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-pq 1) || exit 1; new=$((cur + 5 * $1)); [ $new -lt 1 ] && new=1; [ $new -gt 100 ] && new=100; CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper set-pq 1 $new >/dev/null || exit 1

Contrast@@CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-pq 2@@cur=$(CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-pq 2) || exit 1; new=$((cur + 5 * $1)); [ $new -lt 1 ] && new=1; [ $new -gt 100 ] && new=100; CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper set-pq 2 $new >/dev/null || exit 1

Saturation@@CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-pq 3@@cur=$(CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-pq 3) || exit 1; new=$((cur + 5 * $1)); [ $new -lt 1 ] && new=1; [ $new -gt 100 ] && new=100; CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper set-pq 3 $new >/dev/null || exit 1

Hue@@CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-pq 4@@cur=$(CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-pq 4) || exit 1; new=$((cur + 5 * $1)); [ $new -lt 1 ] && new=1; [ $new -gt 100 ] && new=100; CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper set-pq 4 $new >/dev/null || exit 1

Sharpness@@CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-pq 5@@cur=$(CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-pq 5) || exit 1; new=$((cur + 5 * $1)); [ $new -lt 1 ] && new=1; [ $new -gt 100 ] && new=100; CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper set-pq 5 $new >/dev/null || exit 1

Power mode@@case $(CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-power) in 0) echo Standby;; 1) echo Direct;; *) echo error: unknown mode;; esac@@cur=$(CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper get-power) || exit 1; new=1; [ $cur = 1 ] && new=0; CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin io.github.probonopd.hy310projection.Helper set-power $new >/dev/null || exit 1
Audio mode@@sh $P/system.sh audio get@@sh $P/system.sh audio step $1
External input at startup@@sh $P/system.sh bootsrc get@@sh $P/system.sh bootsrc step $1
Screen saver@@sh $P/system.sh saver get@@sh $P/system.sh saver step $1
Button sound@@sh $P/system.sh btnsound get@@sh $P/system.sh btnsound step $1
USB debug (adb)@@sh $P/system.sh adb get@@sh $P/system.sh adb step $1
Lamp brightness (90 or 100)@@sh $P/system.sh lamp get@@sh $P/system.sh lamp step $1
Factory reset@@sh $P/system.sh reset get@@sh $P/system.sh reset step $1
Timed shutdown@@sh $P/power.sh timeoff get@@sh $P/power.sh timeoff step $1
Bluetooth speaker@@sh $P/power.sh btspeaker get@@sh $P/power.sh btspeaker toggle
